tileset.use: tile index table + wall autotile lookup

audio.formatRule: load the .ogg where canPlayType('audio/ogg; codecs=vorbis') else the .m4a (Safari)

boot.policy: all sfx, ui, stingers (~14 MB decoded)

title.policy: mus_title — unload when a run starts

run.policy: mus_explore, mus_combat_a, amb_cave — load at run start

floor3.policy: mus_combat_b — load on floor 3 entry, unload mus_combat_a

boss_a.policy: mus_boss_a_p1/p2 — load on floor 1-2 boss-room entry (during the 900 ms pan), unload after boss_death

boss_final.policy: mus_boss_final_p1..p3 — load on floor 3 boss-room entry, unload mus_combat_b first

textureUnitBudget.note: world + ui + 1 tileset page bound in a room (3 of 8 WebGL1 units)
